notes.title: Thank you! + The Future of Alpaca Stacka
notes.notes:
Hi all!!

Firstly: [b]THANK YOU FOR ALL YOUR AMAZING SUPPORT![/b] The feedback has been overwhelming and we couldn't be happier with how it turned out! We love you all and we're so happy to share the adventure of Paz with you ːDː

We love watching [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCk95T5X2EgFNYTHSrrgeAsA]all the YouTube videos[/url] made by players and [url=https://www.speedrun.com/alpaca_stacka]the speed-running community[/url] is incredible!

We're honored to have Alpaca Stacka been named one of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/top_July_2021?tab=2]July's top steam releases[/url]! Alpaca Stacka even got a [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/one-of-julys-biggest-steam-hits-was-a-free-chicken-stacking-game-you-can-finish-in-5-minutes/]PC Gamer article[/url] written about Alpaca Stacka! Crazy!

So... what's next for Paz? Well... they're taking a break right now...

The developers do not plan on releasing more content in the future, but if you'd like to follow their future work please follow [url=https://twitter.com/michelle_mxh_ma]michelle_mxh_ma[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/sebbaracaldo]Sebastian Baracaldo[/url] on Twitter. The only updates to Alpaca Stacka will be localization and accessibility related.

...but we do have some good news!

[b]If you liked Alpaca Stacka, you'll love the other games Spookulele Games is publishing![/b] Epically [url=https://dreamlandconfectionery.com/]Dreamland Confectionery[/url]!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1612560/Dreamland_Confectionery/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40700882/48d69fd1b9be5d8bab49d443af7ab427d0a3f820.png[/img][/url]
[b]Dreamland Confectionery[/b] is a comforting, reactive, and visually rich narratively driven adventure game about baking, exploring, and reconnecting with a lost childhood dream. Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1612560/Dreamland_Confectionery/]wishlist Dreamland Confectionery[/url] on Steam!

Thank you all again for playing Alpaca Stacka and please feel free to [url=https://twitter.com/spookulele]follow us on Twitter[/url] to keep up to date! ːchirpː
